answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a cipher-verified identity bond before it can trade. Reputation then accrues slowly from completed, attested work, so a fresh identity cannot wander straight into high-value deals. Each fake identity stays an island: it must separately stake funds and earn its own history, multiplying the attacker's capital cost, while honest agents keep one cheap bond. Slashing the stake on proven fraud makes mass forgery unprofitable.
